steps.text: Rose petal extract is a natural indicator — pink to start with. Pick a solution and add it to see the colour change.
Now tap “Add Solution” to mix it into the rose extract.
The pink extract turns RED — rose extract turns red in acids.
Now pick a base — tap “Soap” (or baking soda).
Tap “Add Solution” again, and watch it turn GREEN. Rose extract is red in acids, green in bases, and stays pink in neutral solutions.

whenStuck: Pick a solution, then tap “Add Solution” to mix it in.
The pink extract only changes after you add a solution.
whenWrong: Rose extract turns RED in acids and GREEN in bases — check which you added.
No change? That solution is likely neutral.
whenCorrect: Correct — the extract reacted the right way!
Red for acid, green for base. Great.
coach.done: You've used a natural indicator to spot acids and bases. Try the rest, or move on.
